title: Crimson Lotus in Ceramic Bowl
description: A vibrant red lotus flower with layered petals and a bright yellow center sits in a weathered green ceramic bowl filled with smooth blue-grey stones. The bowl features faded floral motifs and rests on a dark surface against a moody, dimly lit background with subtle geometric overlays.
prompt: A striking red lotus flower with many layered petals and a dense yellow stamen center, emerging from a weathered turquoise-green ceramic bowl decorated with faded blue floral patterns. The bowl is filled with smooth blue-grey pebbles. Dramatic side lighting creates deep shadows and rich color saturation. Dark, moody background with subtle translucent geometric overlays. Highly detailed digital painting style.
